title: Settings
description:
Unknown keys are refused: app-only preferences never belong here, and an
unknown key may be a protection this CLI does not know about.

disabled_rules.description:
Rule ids switched off in the Types settings: their findings are
`ignored`. Unknown ids are inert, so a renamed rule breaks nothing.

excludes.description:
Absolute folders never touched ("Never touch these folders"): reported
as `user.kept`, never cleaned.

min_age_days.description: `rebuildable` findings idle at least this long are selected by default.

notify_low_disk.description: Also notify when a scanned volume is under 10 % free (default: true).

notify_threshold.description: Bytes: the background scan notifies from this much.

roots.description: Absolute folders to scan; empty means the home folder.

skips.description:
Absolute folders never read ("Skip entirely"): not opened, listed in
the report's `not_scanned`, and protected as excludes are. `--skip`
only adds to them.

app.description: The app bundle that registered the scheduler agent.
